raw_segments.text: Aufidius, that I would have spoke of. Being banished fort, he came unto my hearth, presented
to my knife his throat. I took him, made him joint servant with me, gave him way in all
his own desires. Nay, let him choose out of my files, his projects to accomplish, my best
and freshest men. Served his designments in mine own person. Helped to reap the fame which
he did end all his, and took some pride to do myself this wrong. Till at the last I seemed
his follower, not partner, and he waged me with his countenance as if I had been mercenary.
